name: teetime-booking-e2e
description: Playwright E2E tests for the TeeTime staging bay-booking flow (black-box; no app code changes).

scripts.test: playwright test tests/booking-flow.spec.ts tests/booking-reschedule.spec.ts tests/refund-cancel.spec.ts tests/switch-bay-extend.spec.ts --grep "Booking flow|Quick shift|50% refund|no refund|Extend to another bay" --headed
scripts.test:chrome: playwright test tests/booking-flow.spec.ts tests/booking-reschedule.spec.ts tests/refund-cancel.spec.ts tests/switch-bay-extend.spec.ts --grep "Booking flow|Quick shift|50% refund|no refund|Extend to another bay" --headed --project=desktop-chromium
scripts.test:safari: playwright test tests/booking-flow.spec.ts tests/booking-reschedule.spec.ts tests/refund-cancel.spec.ts tests/switch-bay-extend.spec.ts --grep "Booking flow|Quick shift|50% refund|no refund|Extend to another bay" --headed --project=desktop-safari
